# County Kids Club

> Community-run, not-for-profit programs for kids in Prince Edward County, Ontario, Canada — movement and fitness, soccer, Open Gym, running events, and more.

## Programs

- [Programs (markdown)](https://countykidsclub.com/programs.md): Every current program with ages, schedules, locations, costs, registration status, and links. Continuously updated; start here.
